text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey trains diligently alongside 
her friends. Amidst this, the possibility 
of running on turf emerges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown route in the Classic Year 
draws more attention, making it easier to 
spread Feng Shui. Dirt or turf—Copano 
Rickey is faced with a choice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet Copano Rickey— deliberately chose "not 
to choose."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, run in the dirt Fukuryu Stakes to 
test her aptitude. After that, they would 
reconsider challenging turf G1s.
